page.layout: One page of text, one column. Above the title, a woodcut ornament (not text). Title block centred: "ISAGOGE", then the work title in large capitals, then a sub-heading in italic capitals. Then one paragraph opening with a large woodcut initial. Signature mark at the foot.

main_text.head: ISAGOGE
AD LECTIONEM LIBRORUM NOUI TE-STAMENTI OMNIUM, PER ANA-LYSIN EORUM PRIMARIAM SEU GE-neralem, ad rerum & argumentorum sum-mam seriemque facilius intelligen-tia ac memoria com-plectendam.
DE TITULO SEU INSCRIPTIONE TOTIUS VOLUMINIS, deque libris Noui Testamenti ingenere.
main_text.p: INSCRIPTIO generalis arcano & singulari Dei consilio à Veteribus toti codici præfixa hæc est: τῆς καινῆς διαθήκης ἅπαντα. In qua tria distinctè notanda veniunt. 1, quid sit διαθήκη?, hoc est Testamentum seu fedus 2 qua ratione appelletur καινὴ? .i. nouū, scil: testamentum :3. vox ἅπαντα cuius nos ad-moneat.

page.notes: The woodcut initial I is joined to "NSCRIPTIO" as "INSCRIPTIO". Greek words marked [?] (διαθήκη, καινὴ) are hard to read at this scan resolution; the accents and breathings are uncertain. The left margin shows part of the neighbouring page, which is not transcribed. The ornament above the title and the printed signature are not text except for the signature "A. j.", which is transcribed.
